method: OpenAI built-in imagegen; one transparent PNG per asset
source_image_policy: Original generated PNGs copied byte-for-byte into the project. No pixel editing, recoloring, or bitmap re-encoding. Line regions are selected only by the runtime renderer.
reference: User-supplied Animarotta screen recording used to study award hierarchy and timing, not sampled or copied.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent raster victory cartouche for an original sweets-kingdom Japanese family arcade game. Rich Animarotta-like illustrated arcade touch: thick carefully painted contours, sculpted candy gloss, luminous ivory highlights, layered gilded edging, jewel-like sugar and finely drawn ornamental details. A polished 2.5D cartoon illustration, never photorealistic and never a flat vector icon. One centered symmetrical HORIZONTAL emblem, silhouette approximately 2.5 times as wide as tall, wide landscape canvas, ornament fills most of the width. The middle must be a LARGE, quiet, empty dark-plum/burgundy plaque for separately rendered exact game text, about 60 percent of the emblem width and 45 percent of its height; ornament stays mainly around its perimeter. A small blank curved lower ribbon provides a second text area. There must be NO text, letters, numerals, symbols resembling writing, logos, animals, characters, screenshot, UI controls, scene, or watermark. The area outside the complete ornament must be genuinely transparent; preserve clean alpha around glows, no white/black rectangular background or checkerboard. Keep all edges, crown and flourishes within the canvas with breathing room. The output is a finished production image, not a mockup or concept sheet. NORMAL WIN tier: a lively candy-jewel cartouche with warm thick gold edging, turquoise and strawberry-pink enamel, a small gold sugar star crest, scalloped pearlescent frosting, petite cookie fans and curled candy ribbons. The trim is substantial and hand-worked but the crown is modest. Bright white-gold rim lights with a few precise star sparkles. Clean readable plum center. A generous horizontal plaque suitable for a large BINGO announcement.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game texture: ONE long horizontal luminous winning-line connector, genuine transparent background. Rich original Japanese family arcade sweets-fantasy illustration, Animarotta-like hand-painted 2.5D cartoon touch, thick carefully painted outlines, gilded frosting filigree and jewel-like sugar. Wide landscape canvas. Center the connector, filling most of canvas width. At BOTH ends place matching ornate six-point golden star medallions with a large turquoise-and-pink faceted candy jewel; their complete silhouettes are separate from the center ribbon and remain fully inside the canvas. Between them a long STRAIGHT, narrow, richly detailed golden double-rail ribbon with an ivory glowing center, delicate repeated pearl beads, scrolling gold edges and tiny alternating ruby/turquoise candy gemstones. The line is horizontal, not curved or diagonal. Keep the middle 60 percent of the connector visually continuous and approximately uniform in thickness, suitable for stretching along a completed bingo line. Connector is about 8 times wider than its body thickness; end star medallions about 3 times the body thickness. Every decorative element belongs to the ONE connector. Soft warm glints along edges, clean alpha outside. NO text, numbers, logos, scene, characters, UI board, mockup, separate extra objects, rectangular white/black background or checkerboard. It should harmonize with ornate golden candy-and-wafer victory crowns with plum plaques. Transparent background is essential.
